Name: UmiWesker's Spring Modern Farmhouse
Author: UmiWesker
Description:
Hello everyone! This is my first mod ever! I really love the color pallete from madelinealex's recolor farmhouse [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/198]mod[/url] so I decided to design a simple but cute house design while still maintaining the farmhouse vibe. Enjoy!

[b]Note:[/b] I haven't fully test the Alternative Textures version so it would be much appreciated if you let me know if there is any problem.
[size=4]
Installations:[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher(or Alternative Textures if you used AT version.)
[*]Copy the content of the zip file into your Mods folder
[*]Enjoy! You can paint your house at Robin's if you want to(need fully upgraded to be able to paint the house).
[/list]
[size=4]Credits:[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/madelinealex?gameId=1303]madelinealex[/url]﻿ for the inspiration for the color pallete.
[*]ConcernedApe for vanilla asset.
[/list]
